# iAM Capital: Investment Portfolio

> iAM Capital Group Ltd is a global alternative investment group with a portfolio of residential, commercial, hospitality and renewable energy assets across Italy, France and Spain. This site is its interactive investment map: every property, active and sold, on a Google Map and as cards that can be filtered by status, category and country.

## Pages

- [Investment Portfolio](https://iamcapital.vercel.app/investments): the map and the property cards, with links to the properties’ pages on iamcapital.com
